# Test that an agent skill is served and named as one

cd testdir

md2html -http :8112 -nav -depth 6 &
wait-port :8112

# SKILL.md is the landing file of the directory named for the skill, so
# the skill answers to the directory URL
curl -s http://localhost:8112/skills/it2/
stdout 'iTerm2 CLI Automation'

# The navigation names the skill from its frontmatter, not from the
# heading, and links to it rather than dropping it as a landing file
curl -s http://localhost:8112/
stdout '>\s*it2\s*<'
! stdout '>\s*Skill\s*<'

# llms.txt carries the skill and its description
curl -s http://localhost:8112/llms.txt
stdout '\[it2\]\(skills/it2/SKILL\): Control iTerm2 terminals'

-- testdir/index.md --
# Welcome

-- testdir/skills/it2/SKILL.md --
---
name: it2
description: Control iTerm2 terminals.
---

# it2 - iTerm2 CLI Automation

Splitting panes and sending commands.
